coverage: Read the full git log of all 16 small repos on the host (546 commits). Read the bodies and diffs of every revert, every operator "fix" commit, and every autonomous commit in llm-resolver, local-tools, stateful-ui, light-dispatch, ribosome, libp2p, metric-collector and analysis. Host submodules lag the live clones: llm-resolver +6, local-tools +9, stateful-ui +2. I read those 17 live-only commits in substrate-live, for 131 autonomous commits in total. Journals: substrate-live only, from the 09-25 horizon (ribosome, light-dispatch, discovery, register failures). Unit active-state checked on both nodes; compose2-live journals not inspected. SurrealDB queried once, read-only (515 learned- activity rows). HTTP probes: template listing with the Bearer vs ApiKey scheme (401 vs 200), and a nonsense-route control (404). One POST to /v2/activities/execution-traces/reach with a nonexistent execution id, to prove the route exists (200); it touched no real row. conversation-vessel, user-vessel, metabob-cloud-dashboard, react-renderer and terminal were classified by log, gitignore and deployment status only, not read in depth. git log -G was used for the shell-timeout identifiers and the impulse.*pointer envelope unwrapping; duplicate_policy was checked with grep.

problems.symptom: Autonomous commits that are comment-only, cosmetic, overwritten before read, duplicated Map keys, gap-id literals written into strings, or narrative code at the wrong site
problems.root_cause: the landing gate checks typecheck, literal presence or a judge, not behavioral change at the defect site; recommit children land after the parent defect is already fixed

problems.symptom: Same gap id landing 2-5 times; recommit-recommit-…-semantic_reject chains
problems.root_cause: children of semantically closed or judge-rejected gaps are treated as fresh work; no depth bound; no already-fixed check

problems.symptom: SA landings introduce defects: 30s shell cap, second spawn site, typecheck break, empty new_string rejection, gap flood
problems.root_cause: verify passes on typecheck and suite; no behavioral falsifier for primitives every other path depends on

problems.symptom: Operator fixes reverted or reversed within days; operator reverted a correct autonomous fix and re-derived it 14 days later; discovery validation broke ribosome registration
problems.root_cause: a fix at one junction without grepping sibling call sites and consumers (ribosome shapes:[]); reverts without a recorded reason

problems.symptom: Verify killed at 30s, orphaned pipelines for hours, unbounded concurrent test runs, wrong cwd

principles: A stated rule with no code check is a comment. (local-tools dded800)
A test that re-implements its subject is worse than no test. (local-tools 7a38f37, analysis afb6955)
A no-silent-caps guard that trusts the request instead of the response is not a guard. (light-dispatch 8de5cfa)
Suppressing repetition must not suppress recurrence; a condition that cannot be resolved by filing a gap must not file one repeatedly. (llm-resolver 789853a)
A negative is unattributed until a positive control shares its address. (llm-resolver 789853a)
De-advertising is the correct reaction and a poor detection. (llm-resolver 0768990)
A default is a last resort, not a route; a pin is a preference, not a mandate. (llm-resolver 272edbd, 5b199b3)
Policy arms and routable models are not the same set; a dry default must not blackhole a live plane. (04b2e8f)
A configured id the provider does not serve is a phantom arm. (dd9d886)
Do not record a provider's billing state as model quality. (3068940)
Extract on the honest reach verdict, never on exit status; do not fork the reach primitive (law 3). (ribosome a54691d)
Two writers with different rules is the defect: fix the write side, not the read side. (ribosome 5a374df)
Corpus-check a hard-fail gate against real traffic before landing it. (local-tools b42db41, 67a9e71)
Information at the right time: return the real surrounding lines when an anchor misses. (local-tools 52928b8)
Slow the fleet, never make it unable to verify itself: governors fail open. (local-tools 44c2b21)
A verify with no exit code is the signature of a kill, not a failure. (local-tools e4d604c)
A 401 must say whether to reissue a credential or repair a network path. (discovery 7978682)
Comments are what a future reader reads; a refuted mechanism story in a comment is a defect. (local-tools 81c8f57)
Do not override a documented design principle app-wide unilaterally; fix the one O(table) query. (metabob-cloud-dashboard 3f5e35e)
Tag deliberately non-extractable telemetry reached:false rather than leaving it ungraded. (identity 01af799)
